name: Seated Anterior Delt Press
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press the weights overhead to full extension.
Avoid shrugging the shoulders toward your ears.
Lower with control. A seated overhead press focused on the front delts.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Seated Anterior Delt Press is a beginner pushing exercise for the front delts, performed with dumbbells. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
